Review 1: Games & Song

Play four fun games to review every letter sound from Aa to Ff, then sing the ABC line!

▶️ Watch and Review

Listen to the word. Tap the picture that matches!

🙂 Do You Hear the Same Sound?

Each picture is compared to the target letter. Does it start with the same sound?

🔗 Match and Say

Tap a capital letter, then tap its matching picture and small letter.

🎲 Play the Game

Spin, answer the picture challenge, and move along the board to the End!

🎯
🔤 Complete the Word

Pick the letter that finishes each word!

🔠 Put the Letters in Order

Tap the letters from A to F in the right order!

🎵 Sing the Song

Tap a letter to hear it, then press Play to sing the whole line!
